::: {.callout-note title="Where you are in your learning journey" icon=false}
**Where you come from.** You arrive here from [Data Visualization](data-visualization.qmd) and [Pivoting and joining](pivoting-and-joining.qmd). You can make basic plots and reshape data into long format.

**What this module adds.** You'll use faceting, multiple layers, grouped and interactive plots, and polish figures for publication.

**Why it is valuable.** Reshaped data lets you compare many variables or groups in a single figure, which is what most real research plots require.
:::
